manuscript_statement: YOLO11 achieves 34.54% mAP@50 and 16.74% mAP@50-95 on 436 real test photos
YOLO11 dataset consists of 2,813 real photographic images partitioned into 1,935 train, 442 val, and 436 test images
EfficientNetV2-S achieves 96.62% accuracy and 94.34% macro-F1 across 8 classes on 473 test photos
ResNet34-U-Net achieves 64.18% mean Dice and 51.78% mean IoU on 69 held-out patient pairs using fixed threshold tau = 0.50
Sensor classifier achieves 96.34% overall accuracy and 89.85% macro-F1 across 1,228 test windows
Sensor model architecture is an XGBoost gradient-boosted tree classifier operating on 7 kinematic features
Multimodal XGBoost achieves 83.33% accuracy (25/30) with 95% Wilson CI [66.44%, 92.66%] on held-out test data
Multimodal fusion dataset consists of 200 synthetic feature vectors without paired hospital clinical trials
4-Qubit VQC achieves 56.67% accuracy (17/30) on leak-free grouped test split and 53.33% on sequential slice
VQC operates on PennyLane default.qubit CPU simulator and does not claim quantum computational advantage
Questionnaire + Sensor ablation achieves 90.00% accuracy (27/30) and 0.8693 macro-F1
Pain score is normalized from integer 0-10 to continuous 0-1 via F7 = Pain_raw / 10.0
Severity index is defined as 0.4*pain + 0.3*peak_g + 0.3*affected_area with cutoffs <0.32, 0.32-0.58, >=0.58
System blocks clinical diagnostic claims at runtime when paired clinical labels are absent
AI-QTriage is ready for autonomous clinical emergency triage without clinician oversight
